scripts.build: npm run build -w @shahimat/harness && npm run build -w @shahimat/expectations
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @shahimat/harness && npm run build -w @shahimat/expectations && npm run typecheck -w @shahimat/harness && npm run typecheck -w @shahimat/expectations && tsc -p expectations && tsc -p harness
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run build -w @shahimat/harness && npm run build -w @shahimat/expectations && npm run typecheck -w @shahimat/harness && npm run typecheck -w @shahimat/expectations && tsc -p expectations && tsc -p harness && npm run lint && npm test && npm run index:check && npm run expect
